messages:
Mira Chen: Quick question: our Go SDK surfaces a RateLimitError with RetryAfter, but JS currently surfaces a generic HttpError (status + message). This breaks sample-app retry wrappers; Go retries, JS fails immediately. Anyone seen this?
Alejandra Rivera: Yeahcustomers with polyglot stacks hit inconsistent behavior.
Kevin Lowe: Is it only 429 or do 503s behave similarly? Also nginx 499 is muddy.
Mira Chen: Mainly 429/503. 499 is tricky: some clients treat it as transient and retry, causing duplicate work.
Samir Patel: Suggestion: a minimal typed error contract across SDKs: [code, http_status, retryable, retry_after_ms?, transient_hint?] — small and stable.
Chloe Park: +1. Also include a one-line human_readable_hint for onboarding.
devex-bot: Internal doc stub: https://redwood.dev/internal/error-contracts
Alejandra Rivera: For JS/TS return an Error subclass with exported type guards. e.g., `if (isRetryable(err)) ...` or `err.retryable`.
Kevin Lowe: Need stable canonical codes (snake_case) rather than mixing http_429 vs rate_limited.
Samir Patel: Proposed codes: rate_limited, service_unavailable, auth_required, bad_request, client_abort. Will add mapping table in RFC.
Mira Chen: Also ensure streaming endpoints follow same shape; partial responses can emit different errors.
Chloe Park: Sample-apps: update wrappers to check `err.retryable` and use `err.retry_after_ms` when present. Show idempotent vs non-idempotent patterns.
Samir Patel: I'll open an RFC PR with the shape + mapping and add a test harness that verifies JS/Go/py serialize the same fields.
Kevin Lowe: Note: some SDKs drop headers like Retry-After when wrapping HTTP libs — we must parse `Retry-After` into retry_after_ms during SDK error construction.
Mira Chen: For 499, default to non-retry unless we can detect a client abort; add `client_aborted` flag if detectable.
Chloe Park: I'll add a quickstart snippet in onboarding so customers have a clear retry example.
Samir Patel: Snippet idea: ```js
try { await client.generate(...) } catch (err) {
  if (err.retryable && idempotentOp) {
    await backoff.retry(() => client.generate(...), {delay: err.retry_after_ms || 1000})
  } else {
    throw err
  }
}
```
Alejandra Rivera: I'll sync docs + sample apps to include mapping table and quickstart snippet.
Kevin Lowe: I'll grep for `Retry-After` usage in services and file issues for missing passthrough.
Mira Chen: Action items: Samir RFC + tests, Alejandra docs + samples, Kevin header audit, Chloe onboarding snippet. I'll start a follow-up thread for streaming-specific error shapes. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Opening RFC PR in ~30m.
Kevin Lowe: Filing a few issues now.
Chloe Park: Created onboarding ticket.
Mira Chen: Thanks team — this should reduce noisy support and make SDK behavior predictable across languages.
